addons.addonDescription: LIFEPUNCH™ ULX for DXRP — permission-aware staff console with live roster, 25 commands, waypoints, audit viewer, and owner settings. Opens via lifepunchulx / /lifepunchulx (aliases menu, ulx).

Upgradable tiered money printers with a custom 3D model and interactive in-world upgrade screen. Comes in 3 tiers (Tier 1–3), each upgradeable across print amount, storage, speed, auto-bank, silencer & cooling. Balance and upgrades persist through restarts via snapshot. Fully server-configurable & optimised

Monnow's Fishing brings a fully-featured fishing minigame to your DXRP server. Cast your line, reel in 25 unique fish across 5 rarities, level up through 20 tiers of progression and complete quests for bonus rewards. Includes a Fish Dealer NPC with a full UI, persistent leaderboard, world leaderboard board, admin tools and full portal config support.
